text.description_html:
Emtek 8475US14/US26 Neos Single Cylinder Deadbolt with Custom Finish

The Emtek Neos Single Cylinder Deadbolt looks straight off the trendiest architecture in Miami. It features the modern art deco style that drives the style of Miami. The Single Cylinder Neos Deadbolt is easy to install and will fit doors 1-3/4 inches thick with 2-3/4 inch or 2-3/8 inch backsets. This is a single cylinder deadbolt so the latch is thrown and retracted by a thumb turn on the interior and by a key from the exterior. Finish is custom with polished nickel exterior and polished chrome interior.

Single Cylinder: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by a key from exterior and by a thumb turn from the interior

Features of the Modern Neos Single Cylinder Deadbolt:

  • Keyway: Schlage C
  • Solid brass collar and rosette.
  • Hardened steel bolt.
  • Packaged with a extension collar for thin doors.
  • Will fit standard 2-1/8" door preparations.

Specifications of the Contemporary Neos Door Lock:

  • Height: 2-3/4"
  • Width: 2-1/2"
  • Exterior Projection: 5/8"
  • Interior Projection: 1"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 3-1/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Finish: Polished Nickel
  • Interior Finish: Polished Chrome
